about_short_description.short_description: Shadeform is a contracting company that designs and installs shade sails, retractable awnings, canopies, and blinds.

product.name: Shaderunner® Retractable Sail System
product.description: A retractable shade sail system that provides flexible sun and weather protection for outdoor areas.

product.name: Shade Sails
product.description: Custom-made shade sails constructed with marine-grade fittings and stainless steel wire edges for sun protection.

product.name: Canopies and Shade Structures
product.description: Custom canopies and shade structures using translucent waterproof PVC fabric over powder-coated galvanized steel frames.

product.name: Outdoor Blinds
product.description: External blinds made with aluminium powder-coated headboxes and Soltis PE fabric for sun and weather protection.

product.name: Awnings
product.description: Cassette-style retractable awnings made with aluminium headboxes, offering adjustable shade for outdoor areas.

product.name: Retractable Roofs
product.description: Flexible retractable roofing systems that control sun, wind, and rain for outdoor alfresco areas.
